unit: NZD per m2 of building floor area, GST exclusive, Christchurch

band.unit: NZD per m2 of building floor area, GST exclusive, Christchurch
band.basis: Low = shallow excavate-and-replace/geogrid build-up CHC 218.8 + allowance 15 = 233.8. High = TC3 Type 1 imported-GAP40 deeper build-up CHC 420 + allowance 40 = 460. The two QV build-ups are alternative treatment methods/depths, not additive; the band spans them. Construction only; excludes building foundations/structural work and geotechnical investigation and design (pinned exclusions), and excludes design, verification testing and construction monitoring unless confirmed in scope. Illustrative only: a 1,000 m2 footprint gives roughly $234k-$460k.

band.unit: NZ$/m2 of building floor area (GST exclusive)
band.basis: Envelope of the mainstream Christchurch liquefaction ground-improvement solutions: low = QV current Christchurch shallow reinforced gravel replacement/recompaction (~$219/m2, unwidened) plus the minor dewatering/set-out allowance ($15); high = QV current Christchurch deep imported GAP40 replacement with two geogrid layers (TC3 Type 1, $420/m2) plus the allowance ($40). Stone columns at 4 m depth (QS-measured Pilot rate $145-195/m2 of treated footprint, 2015/16 construction-cost-only dollars) sit inside this envelope for typical treatment ratios. Higher-cost methods (driven timber poles ~$240-270/m2 treated; HSM beams ~$410-522/m2 treated) are above the band and are listed for reference only. All figures GST exclusive, construction cost only, per m2 of building floor area; QV rows are unreviewed. 'How common': CCC has mapped liquefaction vulnerability across all flat land in Christchurch District and uses it to set building controls (source-4), and MBIE Module 5 notes dense granular replacement has been a common Christchurch rebuild method (source-3) — the hazard is widespread and mapped city-wide, not a rare local anomaly; a single published percentage figure could not be sourced (web search was rate-limited). For a 1,000 m2 single-storey building this is roughly $235k-$460k.

band.unit: NZD per m2 of building floor area, GST-exclusive, construction only
band.basis: Sum of the six priced components (low 104.1 / high 379.3, rounded). Priced on the stated assumption of SOIL REPLACEMENT ground improvement: excavate the liquefiable crust and replace with compacted GAP65 gravel reinforced with triaxial geogrid and a separation geotextile, at 0.5-1.5 m depth (central case 1.0 m = approx. $250/m2: excavate $80 + hardfill $126 + geogrid $12.8 + geotextile $6.3 + allowances approx. $25). This is the method QV CostBuilder itself prices; the QV TC1/TC2 table describes it as 'excavate and replace upper layers of soil with compacted, well-graded gravels, geogrid'. QV rates are CHC rates, per m2 of floor area, and are UNREVIEWED (caveated per row). Rates are derived from residential/light-building guidance details, so commercial scale may soften unit rates while poor site access may harden them - the band is widened for this. By method: low = 0.5 m replacement, high = 1.5 m replacement; if the geotech specifies a deeper or structural treatment (stone columns / vibro replacement, compaction grouting, deep soil mixing, dynamic compaction) this band does NOT apply - those have no published NZ rate and must be contractor-quoted (Menard NZ, Hiway Stabilizers, Mainmark) with design by Tonkin & Taylor / WSP / Aurecon. Allowances are approx. 10% of the total, so the band is driven by the QV-priced excavate/fill, not by judgement. Excludes foundations and structural work, geotechnical investigation and design, testing and construction monitoring, and repairs to existing damage, per the pinned scope.
